notes.label: Juxtaposition
notes.body: The city's name sits right next to "secret", so the reader sees at once that they mean to hide the truth.

notes.label: Irony
notes.body: Euenius once hid the loss of the sheep; now the city hides the oracle from him, so they behave just as he did.

notes.label: Characterisation
notes.body: The men chosen for the job are not named, which makes them seem like tools of the city's plan.

notes.label: Polyptoton
notes.trans: to carry out … they carried out
notes.body: The same verb in two forms shows the plan being put into action exactly as arranged.

notes.label: Emphatic position
notes.body: "Like this" ends the clause and points forward, so the reader expects a carefully planned scheme.

notes.label: Vivid detail
notes.trans: while Euenius was sitting on a bench
notes.body: The blind man sitting quietly on a bench makes a pitiful picture, so the reader feels for him as the trap closes.

notes.label: Imperfect tense
notes.trans: they sat down … made conversation … came round
notes.body: A run of imperfects shows the conversation unfolding step by step, so the reader sees how patiently the trap is set.

notes.label: Characterisation
notes.body: They talk about other things first, which shows how cunningly they avoid the real subject.

notes.label: Irony
notes.body: Their sympathy is only a step in the plan, so the reader knows it is not sincere.

notes.label: Repetition
notes.body: The same verb was used in line 46 when they took him to court, so the men who once led him to trial now lead him into a trap.

notes.label: Hypothetical question
notes.body: The optative with ἄν makes it sound like a casual "what if", so Euenius does not realise he is being offered a real deal.

notes.label: Dramatic irony
notes.body: The citizens pretend the payment depends on the city's goodwill, but the reader knows the gods have ordered it.

notes.label: Polyptoton
notes.body: The word for compensation appears twice in different forms, which keeps the reader focused on the payment the city is trying to keep small.
